title: SPIDER dataset row v0.1 (provenance columns only)
description: Checks the provenance and split columns of one dataset row (one package VERSION). Feature columns are not described here and may be added freely. NONE of the columns in spider_contract.dataset.LEAKY_COLUMNS may be used as an ML feature.

group_id.description: Split unit. Default = PEP 503 normalized package name, so every version of a package lands in the same split. Campaign clustering may later replace it with 'campaign:<id>'.
